provenance.note: Synthetic paired control probe; not historical runtime evidence, accepted lore, a model result, or authorization to activate semantic testing.

operation: Compare constraints with established cultural outcomes without building an economy.
boundary: Synthetic tool introduction, one material incentive, and one access constraint; no budget, adoption rate, historical trajectory, or actor choice.
input: A new tool becomes available and a subsidy reduces its use cost. A bodily limitation prevents group B from using one specified interface. BASE: adoption, norm change, and any response by B are unknown. VARIANT: add observations that cohort C adopted the tool after two named periods while its formal norm N remained unchanged. Report only these constraints and observations. Do not infer instant adoption, secularization, a unique economic response, B's morality or institutions, population-wide change, or indefinite retention. Accept the observed bounded adoption in VARIANT and keep formal norm separate from practice.
protected_distinction: INTRODUCTION / MATERIAL PRESSURE / BIOLOGY != DETERMINED CULTURAL OUTCOME; OBSERVED ADOPTION != FORMAL NORM CHANGE
forbidden_conversion: Invent a unique outcome or timeline from incentives/biology; expand into macroeconomics; reject established adoption; generalize C to the population.
